_: spec 441 — THE ESTATE'S DECLARATION. See faithnet.estate.json for what each field means.
_kmsTenant: `imb`, not `imbnet`: the tenant was named before the rule that a tenant is named for its estate. Renaming a tenant re-roots every derivation under it, so the name stays and this field says why.
_callerSubjects: The two KMS caller subjects this estate actually holds. A new estate gets `<id>-vault` / `<id>-runtime` from the builder; these two predate the convention, and renaming a caller means re-binding and re-minting its token for no gain. Recorded so the builder verifies what exists instead of demanding a rename.
_residents: The DEMO personas whose custodian keys this Home holds, so the builder can re-issue their DEL-001 session leaves server-side after the interactions key changes (441 §7.2 step 3). A real resident re-issues by clicking through their own Home; this list is never a roster of who lives here.
_altZones: the workers.dev host is a real domain this runtime answers on, so it belongs beside the zones rather than appearing only in A2A_PUBLIC_BASE_DOMAIN where nothing explains it.
_extraOrigins: BROWSER origins the Home admits — not the same list as the serving domains in altZones. The workers.dev host serves the runtime and is not an origin a browser posts from, which is why it is above and not here.
